Quests.Title: The Overheated Room
Quests.Summary: A neighbor's room in the Lofts is baking: the same heat that filled the Pressure House walls. Check the radiator, reroute the Lofts branch at Tamsin's fuse cabinet and let your companion find the hot spot.
Quests.Done: Hollis can sleep without a fan again, and the Lofts branch runs cool. Nessa has a lost instrument on her mind next.

Lines.Speaker: Nessa Vale
Lines.Text: Hollis Quade's room on the ground floor is an oven. Same smell as Tamsin's walls. Would you look before he cooks his goldfish?

Steps.Name: Hollis Quade
Steps.Objective: Meet Hollis in his room on the ground floor.

Lines.Speaker: Hollis Quade
Lines.Text: Radiator's been ticking like a clock all week. I turned it off. It did not care.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to open the radiator panel
Steps.Objective: Open the overheated radiator panel.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: It's off. Stone cold valve, red hot pipe. The heat is coming up the building's branch line.

Steps.Objective: Find the hot spot: your companion's assist (U), or trace the pipe by hand.
Steps.Prompt: Press E to trace the pipe by hand
Steps.Text: The hot spot is a cracked junction behind the wall. It feeds from the Pressure House.

Steps.Objective: Go to the Pressure House fuse cabinet.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to reroute the Lofts branch
Steps.Objective: Reroute the Lofts branch line.
Steps.Text: The Lofts branch clicks over to the cool loop.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: Hollis? Tell him I said sorry. My walls were sweating into his.

Steps.Objective: Go back to the Lofts.

Lines.Speaker: Nessa Vale
Lines.Text: Hollis says his goldfish thanks you. I didn't ask how he knows. There's something else I'd like found, when you have a minute.

Quests.Title: The Lofts' Music Box
Quests.Summary: The Lofts' old music box went out for repair and never came back. Check the freight depot's ledger, recover the damaged instrument from its store room and set it back on the lobby desk.
Quests.Done: The music box is back on the desk, dented but singing. Nessa has one more idea, for the people living under the street.

Lines.Speaker: Nessa Vale
Lines.Text: The music box that used to play at the door went to the freight depot for repair a year ago. Nobody ever brought it back.

Lines.Speaker: Nessa Vale
Lines.Text: It's dented, it's out of tune, and it's ours. Would you fetch it?

Steps.Objective: Go to the Rift Freight Depot and step inside.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to check the depot ledger
Steps.Objective: Check the depot ledger for the Lofts' music box.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Veyra Lofts, one music box, repair pending. Shelf four. Pending for eleven months.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to lift the music box from the shelf
Steps.Objective: Recover the damaged music box from the store room.
Steps.Text: Dented brass, a cracked lid, and one note still inside.

Steps.Objective: Bring the music box home to the lobby desk.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to set the music box on the desk
Steps.Objective: Set the music box on the lobby desk.
Steps.Text: It plays three notes, stops, then plays three more. Like a knock, but kinder.
Nessa's old repair notes add a utility recipe to the Forge.

Lines.Speaker: Nessa Vale
Lines.Text: There it is. Dented and singing. That's this building in one object.

Quests.Title: A Warm Corner

Quests.Done: The refuge has a warm corner now, and Ilse made sure everyone knows who brought it. Home reaches further than the front door.

Lines.Speaker: Nessa Vale
Lines.Text: The people in that refuge have cots and lanterns, but nowhere warm for the little ones. We have a spare heater. Odile has blankets.

Lines.Speaker: Nessa Vale
Lines.Text: Take them down. Home is a thing you can carry.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to crate up the spare heater
Steps.Objective: Crate up the Lofts' spare heater.
Steps.Text: Heavy, rattly, and still works.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to collect Odile's spare blankets
Steps.Objective: Collect Odile's spare blankets at Bondkeeper's Refuge.

Lines.Speaker: Odile Marsh
Lines.Text: Wash them first if they ever come back. They won't come back. Good.

Steps.Objective: Take everything down to the residents' corner of Lantern Refuge.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to set up the warm corner
Steps.Objective: Set up the warm corner.
Steps.Text: The heater ticks on. Two children claim the blankets at once.

Lines.Speaker: Ilse Varro
Lines.Text: Look at that. A corner that's warm on purpose. I'll make sure everyone knows the Lofts sent it, and who carried it.

Quests.Title: Bond and Chassis
Quests.Summary: Your bike runs hot after every fusion. Not dangerous, annoying. Park in Jax's bay, read the coupler diagnostics and find the mismatch, without stripping a single part of your own.
Quests.Done: Found it: a shim, cut from Jax's own stock. Nothing of yours was used. Jax wants to try a second handling profile next.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Your frame runs hot after every fusion. Not dangerous. Annoying. And annoying gets dangerous if you ignore it long enough.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Bring it in. We find the problem without taking anything of yours apart. Shop rule.

Steps.Objective: Ride your own bike into Jax's bay and stop.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to read the coupler diagnostics
Steps.Objective: Step off and read the coupler diagnostics.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Resonance spikes on the left side only. The coupler and the frame disagree about where the creature sits.

Steps.Objective: Let your companion hum at the coupler (U), or run Jax's manual diagnostic.
Steps.Prompt: Press E to run Jax's manual diagnostic
Steps.Text: The mismatch is a gap of two millimetres between the coupler and the frame.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to fit the shim Jax cut
Steps.Objective: Fit the shim Jax cut from his own stock.
Steps.Text: The shim slides home. No part of yours was used.
A second chassis trim is yours: Jax's apology for his first coupler.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Two millimetres. Two. I'm going to lie down. Then I want to try a second handling profile on you.

Quests.Done: The second profile works and Jax wrote it into your coupler as a sidegrade. He has heard of a rare coupler deep in the workshops.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Profile two. Tighter turns, shorter glide, harder stop. Not better. Different. You pick what fits your hands.

Steps.Objective: Mount your bike in the bay and hold N to fuse.
Ride Jax's second course: use the form's ability twice and stop clean.

Steps.Text: separate
Steps.Objective: Stop somewhere open and hold N to separate.

Steps.Text: Handling sidegrade written to your coupler: switch profiles at Jax's bay.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Good hands. Now, rumor says there's a rare coupler in the Crucible Workshops, guarded by things that fix themselves. Interested?

Quests.Done: Jax fitted the rare coupler to a cruiser frame. A second compatible vehicle class is yours, no money involved.

Lines.Text: A rare coupler. Old foundry make. With it I can tune a cruiser frame to carry a bond, not just your bike. Bring it, and the cruiser's yours.

Steps.Objective: Find the coupler room in the Crucible Workshops.
Clear the coupler room. Hit the repair constructs first or they mend the sentinel.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to pry the rare coupler loose
Steps.Objective: Pry the rare coupler loose.
Steps.Text: Old foundry brass, and it hums when your companion gets close.

Steps.Objective: Bring the rare coupler to Jax's bay.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Oh, that's beautiful. Give me ten minutes and a cruiser frame.

Steps.Text: Cruiser chassis class unlocked: a second vehicle that can carry a bond.

Quests.Done: The clinic's cold drawer is full. Mara packed you a care kit and asked a favor for Odile.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Burn cases from the canals. I need cold salts, the clean blue kind. There's a cool pocket down there where they grow like frost on a window.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Take only what's loose. A pocket you strip bare doesn't grow back.

Steps.Objective: Find the cool pocket in the Ember Canals.
Gather the loose coolant salt in the cool pocket.
Bring the salts to Mara Solane Street Clinic.
Hand Mara four Coolant Salts for the cold drawer.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to stock the cold drawer
Steps.Objective: Stock the clinic's cold drawer.
Steps.Text: Four salts, packed in cloth. Enough for a bad week.
Mara's care kit: useful consumables and better companion care.

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Thank you. Now, Odile has a lost kiln crab and no time. Would you walk it home?

Steps.Objective: Coax the kiln crab into the carrier.

Quests.Title: Quiet Hands
Quests.Summary: A canal worker came in with a crystal burn that will not cool. Read his chart, prepare a cooling poultice and treat him in the clinic, with your companion close enough to keep him calm.
Quests.Done: Teo walked out on his own two feet. Mara tuned your ward's glow to match her clinic lamps, which is either a gift or a joke.

Phases.Title: A burn that will not cool

Lines.Speaker: Mara Solane
Lines.Text: Canal worker, crystal burn, scared out of his mind. I need steady hands and a calm creature in the room. You have both.

Steps.Objective: Go into the clinic.

Steps.Name: Teo Marsh
Steps.Objective: Sit with the patient, Teo Marsh.

Steps.Objective: Read Teo's chart.

Lines.Text: My entry says a sealed cache sits behind the Reliquary columns. The Office's copy puts it in a dead-end vault. One of them is lying, and I want to know which.

Steps.Objective: Read the archive's entry.
